description.narrative: - To distribute rapid response grants to women and non-binary human rights defenders, activists and their organizations impacted by the current crisis in Afghanistan. Afghan women and girls and non-binary people are facing critical challenges at this time as the Taliban has taken control of the country. - UAF Asia & Pacific is deeply integrated within local networks in the region. It relies on an advisor network where possible for grantee endorsements and on trusted peer donor networks that provide vetting for applicants (for example Women & Peace Studies Organisation - Afghanistan). It accepts applications for funding in any language, any day of the year, for up to USD $5000. Once submitted, applicants receive a response within 72 hours. If approved, the grant is delivered in 10-15 days. - UAF A&P's grants play a key role in supporting the resilience of women and LBTQI+ activists and defenders at critical moments. UAF A&P's grantee partners work across a variety of social change movements in Asia and the Pacific, including environmental and climate justice, feminist, anti-corruption, land rights, anti-violence and LBTQI+ movements
